items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I did hear the band. Buddy Bowling

ctx.x: I did hear the band. Buddy Bowling, Marion Perez, and Nick Clark Crowe, and all that. And a bunch of them was different bands with the Imperial, the Superior, and Buddy Bowling, and what you called Jim Brown, all them. I remember that. But that was above my time. I wasn't playing. I was trying to play. You see, I was trying to play because I had but one song I played. Hey, what song was that really? That was the Got Good Bullies, so they say. What was that again?
Your Got Good Bullies, so they say.

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I was pushing that. That's the most I can remember of it now.

ctx.x: I was wondering about something else, too. What about this Buddy Bowling, you know, his number, Funky Butt? How did that go? Can you hear me?
I was pushing that. That's the most I can remember of it now.
I saw it. How would Buddy Variant?
